name: guide-proof
subtitle: Check that a setup guide can actually be followed
title: Guide Proof
installMethods: zip upload in Claude apps (Settings > Capabilities > Skills)

permissions.files: Reads its own checklist and any guide file the user points at. Writes nothing.
permissions.shell: None. It does not run the commands in the guide. Bundles no scripts.
permissions.network: None required. It does not open the guide's links.
